O período para ofertar termina em 3 dias, 17 horas
I already have a React-based site running and now need a handful of new pages that focus on user interaction. The work breaks down into three tightly-linked pieces: • User-centric pages – Build clean, responsive screens that guide visitors through sign-ups, in-app actions and profile management. React Router is set up; your components just need to slot in smoothly. • Blog integration – Pull and render blog posts from an existing JSON feed (or Markdown files if you prefer). Infinite scroll or classic pagination is fine as long as loading feels seamless. • Interactive quizzes – Create a reusable quiz component that supports single- and multi-choice questions, real-time scoring and a final results screen. Animations and progress indicators should feel snappy yet lightweight. I expect modern React (hooks, functional components, contextual state or Redux if justified), clean modular CSS/Sass or a library like Material UI/Tailwind, and TypeScript would be a bonus. All code should be lint-clean, well-commented, and delivered through a Git repo so I can review commits. Acceptance criteria: 1. Pages render with zero console errors and match supplied Figma frames. 2. Blog feed populates dynamically and remains accessible without JS glitches. 3. Quiz component shows correct/incorrect states, records scores, and emits a results object I can hook into analytics. If this fits your wheelhouse, let’s get started right away.
